Redwood Incident Bot: ALERT: spike in 5xxs from inference-gateway across us-west-2 and eu-west-1. threshold breach (1m) -> 12% errors. paging on-call.
Automated Pager: paging @Maya Chen (on-call) — high severity SLO breach for inference-gateway. runbook: prefix-kv-cache check, route failovers.
Maya Chen: on it. seeing customer-facing 502s and gateway timeouts. which stack should we triage first?
Eric Patel: logs show a ton of `prefix_cache.evictions` and `kv_store.get` timeouts. likely eviction storm. grabbing metrics.
Jin Park: can we confirm if prefetch workers are throttled? last deploy to runtime had prefetch tuning.
Priya Ramaswamy: beginning quick impact assessment: error rate by product route: `/v1/generate` 14% 502s, `/v1/embeddings` 9% 504s. Some large customers report retries.
Maya Chen: ok plan: 1) silence noisy alerts 2) add temporary bypass route to skip prefix cache for critical routes 3) throttle prefetchers / pause prefetch 4) scale kv shard pool if possible.
Eric Patel: silencing non-actionable alerts now :thumbsup:.
Jin Park: posting relevant log snippet: ```
[2026-03-15T02:17:12Z] prefix_shard=shard-12 evict_count=348912 evict_rate=5800/s
[2026-03-15T02:17:12Z] kv_get=timeout shard=shard-12 latency=2500ms err=ETIMEDOUT
[2026-03-15T02:17:13Z] gateway handler=generate status=502 upstream_err=kv_timeout
```
Priya Ramaswamy: customer impact summary for CS: ~7 customers hit >5% error for last 20m, 2 customers experiencing >20% errors. Region breakdown attached.
Maya Chen: executing bypass: Jin, can you push a dynamic route to send `/v1/generate` to model-cache-bypass pool for 10m? we want to stop cascading failures.
Jin Park: on it. `curl -XPOST https://console.internal/routes/update -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","policy":"bypass_prefix_cache","ttl":600}'` -> acknowledged, deploying now.
Redwood Incident Bot: Route update job started (job-id: rj-20260315-4321).
Eric Patel: also recommend reducing prefetch concurrency: `PREFETCH_WORKERS=2` on prefetch-service; current is 20. I'll patch config.
Priya Ramaswamy: doing live metric checks: eviction spikes correlated with a big ingress burst from a particular customer (acct_998). throttling that customer's traffic would help but want org approval.
Maya Chen: do not throttle without approvals. first verify bypass effect.
Jin Park: route update finished. verifying traffic: initial checks show `/v1/generate` error rate dropped from 14% -> 3.2% in us-west-2 within 90s.
Eric Patel: applying prefetch worker scale down now on prefetch-*. -> changed env, restarting pods.
Priya Ramaswamy: note: kv shard pool autoscaler is stuck due to a bug; trying manual scale of kv-proxy nodes.
Maya Chen: who can scale kv? @Eric you have permissions?
Eric Patel: I can scale. bumping kv-node group by +3 now.
Redwood Incident Bot: KV-scale job started (job-id: kvscale-20260315-77). Estimated time 2m.
Jin Park: while kv scales, we should disable prefix prefetch writes to reduce churn: `PREFETCH_WRITE=false` on runtime. patching via configmap.
Priya Ramaswamy: quick check: error rate trending down overall, still seeing intermittent 504s on embeddings route in eu-west-1. might be a different shard.
Maya Chen: assign followups: Jin to finish bypass validation and revert when stable; Eric to monitor kv scaling and errors; Priya to prepare customer impact note and CC CS; I'll stay on and do final handoff.
Jin Park: bypass has held for 20m, latencies stable ~120ms and errors ~2-3%. I'll keep bypass for 30m then plan rollback.
Eric Patel: kv nodes added, health checks passing. `kv_get` timeouts dropped 95% on previously noisy shards.
Priya Ramaswamy: compiling incident timeline for postmortem. key items: prefetch concurrency regression from release, absent eviction backpressure, autoscaler edge-case.
Maya Chen: starting incident call in 5 to sync and do a formal handoff to second on-call at 03:45 UTC.
Redwood Incident Bot: Incident bridge created: https://meet.internal/incident/2480012345
Automated Pager: paging @Priya Ramaswamy for handoff at 03:45 UTC.
Priya Ramaswamy: acknowledged, will take next shift. Current mitigation state: bypass route active, prefetch workers throttled, kv pool scaled +3, alerts suppressed, monitoring boards updated.
Maya Chen: final notes for handoff message to SRE rotation: include commands used, job ids, and list of customers to monitor. Sending a quick summary to #customer-success.
Priya Ramaswamy: copying CS summary now: "We encountered a prefix cache eviction storm causing KV timeouts and gateway 5xxs. Temporary bypass deployed for `/v1/generate`, prefetch throttled, KV pool scaled. Impact: intermittent 502/504s for a subset of customers. Engineers are monitoring; will follow up with root cause and timeline."
Maya Chen: thanks team. I'll close primary channel and let Priya follow for next 4 hours. leaving notes for postmortem: capture prefetch change diff, eviction metrics, autoscaler logs. :white_check_mark:
Priya Ramaswamy: taking over. if anything spikes re-open page.
Maya Chen: incident closed from primary on-call perspective.
